title: System Design for Senior Interviews
audience: Engineers who can already name the components and now have to defend the choices — the round that decides senior versus mid.
description: Assumes the building blocks. Everything here is about what breaks at the seams: where the data is cut, what happens when a machine cannot be reached, how a failure spreads, and how you find out. Each concept is paired with the failure it exists to prevent, because that is the form the question takes.
